'''''UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs. Nolan''''' (also known as '''''UFC Fight Night 292''''' and '''''UFC Vegas 123''''') is an upcoming [[mixed martial arts]] event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that is scheduled to take place on October 31, 2026, at the [[UFC Apex|Meta Apex]] in [[Enterprise, Nevada]], part of the [[Las Vegas Valley]], United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/08/26/ufc-meta-apex-event-approvals/91468590007/|title=UFC officially adds four more Meta APEX events to 2026 schedule|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-08-26|access-date=2026-08-26}}</ref>

==Background==
A lightweight bout between former [[UFC Lightweight Championship]] challenger [[Renato Moicano]] and [[Tom Nolan (fighter)|Tom Nolan]] is scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/14/ufc-331-renato-moicano-vs-brian-ortega-tom-nolan/91768221007/|title=UFC 331 loses main card bout days before event; one fighter gets future main event|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-09-14|access-date=2026-09-15}}</ref>

A welterweight bout between [[Randy Brown (fighter)|Randy Brown]] and former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Welterweight Championship|LFA Welterweight Champion]] Carlos Leal was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/intriguing-welterweight-clash-ufc-vegas-123/|title=Intriguing welterweight clash booked for UFC Vegas 123|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-09-25|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref> However, Leal withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by undefeated prospect Jacobe Smith.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.yardbarker.com/mma/articles/undisclosed_injury_results_in_first_fight_cancelation_for_renato_moicano_headlined_card/s1_17730_44381725|title=Undisclosed injury results in first fight cancelation for Renato Moicano-headlined card|publisher=yardbarker.com|author=Biplob Chakraborty|date=2026-10-03|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/jacobe-smith-accepts-ufc-vegas-123/|title=Jacobe Smith accepts short notice fight for UFC Vegas 123|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-10-19|access-date=2026-10-20}}</ref>

A featherweight bout between Francis Marshall and Gastón Bolaños was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/mma/news/ufc-books-another-dana-whites-contender-series-winner-debut-ufc-fight|title=UFC books another Dana White's Contender Series winner for debut UFC fight|publisher=si.com|author=Drew Beaupre|date=2026-08-26|access-date=2026-08-30}}</ref> However, Bolaños withdrew due to an eye laceration suffered in training and was replaced by Dakota Hope.<ref name="Hope">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/10/08/ufc-news-halloween-vegas-123-gaston-bolanos-francis-marshall-dakota-hope/92158529007/|title=New UFC fight booked for Halloween card after grisly cut|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-10-08|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref>

A flyweight bout between [[Cody Durden]] and [[Ode' Osbourne]] is scheduled for the event.<ref name="Hope"/> They were previously scheduled for [[UFC 329]] in July, but Osbourne had to withdraw due to an undisclosed injury.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/06/23/ufc-329-fight-card-ode-osbourne-off-vs-cody-durden/90667560007/|title=UFC 329 loses fighter due to injury|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-06-23|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref>

A middleweight bout between former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Middleweight Championship|LFA Middleweight Champion]] [[Azamat Bekoev]] and [[Andre Petroski]] was scheduled at the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://region15.ru/boets-ufc-azamat-bekoev-provedet-boj-s-andre-petroski-31-oktyabrya-v-las-vegase/|title=Боец UFC Азамат Бекоев проведет бой с Андре Петроски 31 октября в Лас-Вегасе|publisher=region15.ru|author=Alina Bazzaeva|date=2026-08-21|access-date=2026-08-22}} {{in lang|ru}}</ref> However, the bout was removed from the event due to Bekoev suffering a medical emergency and Petroski was rescheduled to compete at [[UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady]] in one week.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/10/25/ufc-vegas-123-takes-a-hit-as-fighter-withdraws-after-passing-out-at-cvs/|title=UFC Vegas 123 takes a hit as fighter withdraws after passing out at CVS|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Jordan Ellis|date=2026-10-25|access-date=2026-10-26}}</ref>
